name: Stepramp
description: A single fall cut into six flat levels, so the fade is counted rather than smooth.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000000ff 0.0% 16.7%, #000000d5 16.7% 33.3%, #000000aa 33.3% 50.0%, #00000080 50.0% 66.7%, #00000055 66.7% 83.3%, #0000002a 83.3% 100.0%, transparent 100%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000000ff 0.0% 16.7%, #000000d5 16.7% 33.3%, #000000aa 33.3% 50.0%, #00000080 50.0% 66.7%, #00000055 66.7% 83.3%, #0000002a 83.3% 100.0%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
